summary: Vista Energy, S.A.B. de C.V., a Mexican oil and gas issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market share repurchase. On August 5, 2026, the company repurchased 50,000 Series A shares at MXN 1,123.69 per share, totaling approximately MXN 56.18 million, excluding fees and VAT. The buyback was authorized at the April 28, 2026 ordinary shareholders' meeting. Citigroup's Mexican brokerage unit, Citi México Casa de Bolsa, executed the trades. Post-repurchase, 110,967,402 Series A shares remain outstanding and 1,334,351 are held in treasury. This represents a routine execution under an existing capital-return program, not a tender or going-private event.
